visual_goal: Show that every channel adapter calls the same offer API and checkout contract, and every adapter writes to one channel ledger.
prompt: A simple symmetric block diagram. In the center column, three rounded boxes stacked top to bottom: 'Web and apps', 'Metasearch', 'Partner API'. To the right of the center column, one tall box spanning the height of all three, labeled 'Offer API'; each center box sends exactly one solid arrow straight right into it. To the left of the center column, one tall ledger book spanning the same height, labeled 'Channel ledger'; each center box sends exactly one dotted arrow straight left into it. Nothing else: no other boxes, no other arrows.
alt: Web and apps, metasearch and the partner API each send one arrow to a single offer API on the right and one dotted arrow to a channel ledger on the left.

visual_goal: Show the metasearch click checked on arrival: the integration answers the live query from the offer API, then re-quotes the advertised offer when the guest lands and records both totals in the channel ledger.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane diagram with five horizontal lanes, each named at its left edge: 'Metasearch', 'Integration', 'Offer API', 'Landing page', 'Channel ledger'. In the left half, a pair of arrows: one from 'Metasearch' down to 'Integration' labeled 'live query', then one from 'Integration' down to 'Offer API' labeled 'offers', and one arrow returning up from 'Integration' to 'Metasearch' labeled 'prices'. In the right half, a small unlabeled guest figure taps a phone in the 'Landing page' lane with an arrow up into 'Integration' labeled 'click'. Then one arrow from 'Integration' down to 'Offer API' labeled 're-quote', one arrow from 'Integration' down to 'Channel ledger' labeled 'both totals', and one arrow from 'Integration' to 'Landing page' labeled 'match result'. A small green check mark sits beside the landing page.
alt: Swimlanes for metasearch, integration, offer API, landing page and channel ledger: the integration answers a live query from the offer API, and when the guest clicks it re-quotes the offer, records both totals in the ledger and tells the landing page whether the price matches.

visual_goal: Show the partner distribution flow from cached content through live, rate-limited shopping, a binding price check, booking and management, with quotas governing shopping and notifications flowing from management.
prompt: A left-to-right flow of five rounded stations connected by single arrows: 'Content files', 'Shop', 'Price check', 'Book', 'Manage'. Under 'Content files' a small stack of folders with a calendar page; under 'Shop' a magnifying glass; under 'Price check' a small padlocked price tag; under 'Book' a confirmation ticket; under 'Manage' a pencil and an undo arrow. Above 'Shop', a small gauge labeled 'Quotas' with one dotted arrow pointing down into 'Shop'. Below 'Manage', a small bell labeled 'Notifications' with one dotted arrow pointing up into 'Manage'.
alt: A flow from content files to shop, price check, book and manage, with a quotas gauge governing shopping and notifications attached to management.
